scope: Official sources: code.claude.com docs (settings, subagents, model configuration, environment variables, plugins), the Claude Code changelog. Look the facts up even if they seem known; they change often.

result: Main-thread agent `effort` is ignored (a maintainer-confirmed open bug); use `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` or `effortLevel`/`modelSettings` instead. Autocompact can be lowered several ways, and a plugin can ship only `agent` and `subagentStatusLine`.

checks: none run (read-only research). Docs read 2026-11-02 via Exa. The docs mention versions up to about v2.1.305, so they are current.

questions: none

**Agent effort (sourced)**
- The `effort` frontmatter field is documented as "Effort level when this subagent is active. Overrides the session effort level, but not the `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` environment variable." Values are `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`, and the available levels depend on the model. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents
- The docs do not say it applies to a main-thread agent. They do name `--agent` and the `agent` setting for `initialPrompt` and `omitClaudeMd`, and the `omitClaudeMd` note says it is ignored when the agent is the main session agent. `effort` has no such note. Same page.
- A maintainer confirmed on GitHub that frontmatter `effort` is applied only when the agent is dispatched as a subagent. The `--agent` path applies `model`, the system prompt and hooks, but never `effort`. They reproduced it on v2.1.233 and called it a bug. https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/81677
- That issue was closed by the stale bot on 2026-09-14 without a fix. Follow-up #97829 (open, 2026-09-28) reports it still reproduces on v2.1.283. https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/97829
- Inference: don't rely on frontmatter `effort` for a root run via `--agent` or the `agent` setting. I found no changelog entry that fixes it, and I did not test v2.1.305 or later.

**Session effort (sourced)**
- Precedence, first applying wins. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config
  1. `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL`
  2. An in-session pick (`/effort`, the `/model` picker)
  3. `--effort`
  4. Settings (`modelSettings.<model>.effortLevel`, then `effortLevel`)
  5. The model default. This is `high`, except Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 default to `medium`, and Opus 4.7 defaults to `xhigh`.
- The `effortLevel` setting takes `low`, `medium`, `high` or `xhigh` and is scoped "Any file". `max` is not accepted in `effortLevel` or `modelSettings`. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference
- `modelSettings.<model>.effortLevel` takes the same four values and needs v2.1.251 or later. Within one file it outranks the top-level key. Across files, the highest-precedence file that sets either one decides. Same page.
- `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` takes any level name, including `max`. Setting it to `auto` or `unset` makes Claude Code send no effort level. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config
- A top-level `effortLevel` in the user settings file does not count for Opus 5.5 and later models. It still applies to Opus 5 and earlier. In project, local or managed settings, or via `--settings`, it applies to every model. Same page.
- `max` applies to the current session only, unless it comes from the environment variable. Same page.
- An unsupported level falls back to the highest supported level at or below it. `maxEffortLevel` (v2.1.267 or later) caps every source, including the environment variable and frontmatter. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference

**Autocompact (sourced)**
- `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` takes 1-100, a percentage of the auto-compact window. It can only lower the threshold; values above the default are ignored. It applies only in sessions that compact before the model's context limit, and to both main conversations and subagents. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars
- `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW` is a token count from 100000 to 1000000. Suffixes like `200k` need v2.1.304 or later. A bare `200` means 200 tokens. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config
- The `autoCompactWindow` setting takes the same range. The per-model form is `modelSettings.<model>.autoCompactWindow` (v2.1.288 or later), which also accepts `"auto"`. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference
- `--autocompact` sets the window for one launch. `/autocompact 500k` saves it to user settings. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config
- The variable beats the command, the flag and the setting. The flag is not preempted by managed settings. Same page.
- Subagents have an `autoCompactWindow` frontmatter field (100000 to 1000000, v2.1.296 or later). https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents
- Any window is capped at the model's context window. Native-1M models (Fable, Sonnet 5 and later, Haiku 5.5, Opus 4.7 and later) compact at about 967K by default, so lowering works on 1M windows. `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1` compacts them at 200K instead. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config
- Inference: for a small context, `autoCompactWindow: 100000` is the simplest setting. The percentage variable also works but is relative to the window.

**Scope (sourced)**
- A plugin's `settings.json` (or the inline manifest `settings` key) honors only `agent` and `subagentStatusLine`. Every other key is dropped. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/components and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/manifest-reference
- Plugin defaults are the lowest layer, so a user's own `agent` overrides the plugin's. Between two plugins, the one loaded last wins. Same pages.
- So a plugin cannot ship `effortLevel`, `modelSettings`, `autoCompactWindow` or `env`, and so cannot set `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` or `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE`. The feature request to widen this is open: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/65513
- Plugin agents ignore `hooks`, `mcpServers`, `permissionMode` and `initialPrompt`. `effort` and `autoCompactWindow` are not on that list, so they load from a plugin agent (inference). https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents
- `effortLevel` and `autoCompactWindow` are "Any file", so a user, project or local settings file can carry them. The `env` block works in the same files. https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference
- Inference: HolyAgent can ship `agent` through the plugin's `settings.json` to make the root the main thread. The high effort and small context must come from the user or project settings or the environment, for example a project `.claude/settings.json` with `effortLevel` and `autoCompactWindow`. Project settings wait for the folder to be trusted. A user-level `effortLevel` does not apply to Opus 5.5, so per-model `modelSettings` or a project-level `effortLevel` is safer.

notes: the Opus 5.5 `effortLevel` caveat and the open bug are the two points most likely to break a plan that assumes these settings just work.

Session effort: Settings key `effortLevel` (low, medium, high, xhigh) or `modelSettings.<model>.effortLevel`. Environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` (also accepts max, auto, unset). Precedence is env, then in-session pick, then `--effort`, then settings, then the model default. Sources: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference
Autocompact: `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` (1-100%, lowers only), `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW`, `autoCompactWindow` and `modelSettings.<model>.autoCompactWindow` (100000-1000000 tokens), `--autocompact`, `/autocompact`, and subagent `autoCompactWindow`. All are capped at the model's window, and native-1M models compact at about 967K by default. Sources: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars and https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config
Scope: A plugin's `settings.json` honors only `agent` and `subagentStatusLine`, and everything else is dropped (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/components). `effortLevel`, `autoCompactWindow` and `env` must come from user or project settings or the environment (https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings-reference).
